title: TOTAL TOOLS
tickerText: Total Tools has been helping Australian tradies get the job done for more than 30 years. Built around the idea of Every Tool, Every Trade, the business has grown into Australia’s largest independent professional tools retailer and a proudly Australian-owned and operated franchise network. Total Tools brings together leading professional brands including Milwaukee, Makita, DeWalt, Bosch and many more, backed by experienced teams who know tools and understand the needs of people who use them for a living. With more than 20,000 products available across stores and access to over 60,000 products nationwide, customers can shop online or in-store, arrange delivery to the jobsite or use Click & Collect. From everyday essentials to specialised trade equipment, Total Tools is built around range, expert advice, service and helping customers find the right tool for the job
